newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-High Court rules for Aboriginal land claims.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-High Court rules for Aboriginal land claims.

text.p: Australia's High Court found on Monday that the granting of a pastoral lease did not automatically extinguish any Aboriginal land claims on the same area.

The High Court found that the claim of an Aboriginal group, the Wik, over 35,000 square km of land in Queensland may in some cases extinguish the rights of the 12 pastoral leaseholders in that area. The judgement was split four-to-three in favour of the Wik people.
The ruling was seen as a landmark decision which may open the way for further successful native title claims and increases uncertainty for farmers and miners about their land rights.
The case will now go back to Australia's Federal Court, where the Wik people will have to prove their right to the land.
